text:
Elaine: Heads-up — NovaRetail raised onboarding friction during today's check-in; possible renewal risk. Pulling thread to capture feature asks and pain points.
Sam: Thanks — can you paste the direct asks from the call? Are they blocking their rollout?
Elaine: From their PM: 'Dashboard signals are unclear, we can't attribute per-team costs, onboarding docs miss SSO + service-account steps.' They also asked for 'bulk import for prompt templates' and 'export of user annotations for audit'.
Nora: That's helpful. Which of these map to existing roadmap items? Bulk import sounds like a DevEx backlog item; dashboard clarifications could be a quick UX/docs patch.
Miguel: Renewal risk level? Are they on a committed plan or usage-based?
Elaine: They're on hosted usage (~400k tokens/month). They've paused expanding to two additional teams because they can't roll up costs per team.
casey-bot: :warning: Renewal alert created (RNW-382) — renewal in 40 days, health score dropped to 62.
Sam: My prioritization suggestion: 1) Per-team cost breakdown (high impact, medium effort) 2) Bulk prompt CSV import (medium impact) 3) SSO/service-account onboarding guide + checklist (low effort) 4) Export annotations (low/med).
Miguel: I can scope the per-team cost breakdown. Likely backend + console UI; rough estimate 2 sprints for an MVP unless we do a manual CSV workaround.
Elaine: Can Product do a 3-week engineering spike and Solutions Eng run a targeted enablement? If we ship a CSV rollup MVP and a short admin runbook we might stave off churn.
Sam: Agree on MVP approach. Also recommend a paid implementation option — they mentioned being willing to purchase engineering hours to accelerate the cost view.
Nora: I'll schedule a 30m enablement session next Tue and draft a CS playbook for the admin flow. Elaine — can you drop the call recording + raw ask list here?
Elaine: Recording: https://redwood.app/recordings/novaretail-2026-03-18. Raw asks below:
- per-team cost view and route->team mapping
- bulk CSV import for prompt templates
- step-by-step SSO + service account onboarding guide
- export annotations (CSV/JSON) for audit
- improved dashboard labels and examples
Sam: I'll add the per-team cost view to our roadmap board as an experiment and draft a short PRD. Assigning initial scope to @miguel.
Miguel: Got it — I'll post a 1-page spec by Friday with API shape and UI mockups.
Elaine: FYI NovaRetail said they'd pay for a small prioritized engineering block if we can deliver the per-team breakdown sooner.
Sam: Noted — we'll capture as a paid add-on option in the PRD rather than re-prioritizing core quarterly slots immediately.
Nora: Plan summary: (1) Miguel spec by Fri, (2) CS enablement session scheduled Tue, (3) PRD draft + experiment tag on roadmap. Re-check health after enablement. :thumbsup:
Elaine: Tagging for visibility: @sam @miguel @nora @casey-bot. Thanks everyone.
